source_assumptions.scope: Synthetic parameters, not a safety standard or measured capacity; no operations generated by topology

payload_admission.requires: Typed dimensions/orientation/gross mass and source parent state before route/cost; no visual scaling
payload_admission.parcel_target: M07/C02 must adopt a physically smaller fitted parcel; R03 HU and SKU unit packs are distinct

direction_policy: Main one-way East→West; spur direction changes only by source lease/event. Preserve cargo initial yaw offset on reverse; curve tangent is continuous. T changes direction by explicit .8s stopped pivot, not through rail.
queue_policy: Reserve downstream physical cell/resource before transfer; hold upstream on full/blocked. No ghost cargo/throughput from decoration.
output_policy: Line stops inside packing; shipper actually carries payload to finite port staging/service using pedestrian route. No fixed belt crosses protected express throat.
